p, k = map(int, input().split())
used_flags = [False] * p
cycle_count = 0

def dfs_visit(node):
    used_flags[node] = True
    next_node = (node * k) % p
    if not used_flags[next_node]:
        dfs_visit(next_node)

for i in range(p):
    if not used_flags[i]:
        cycle_count += 1
        dfs_visit(i)

res = 1
for _ in range(1, cycle_count + (k == 1)):
    res = (res * p) % 1000000007

print(res)
